name: Formosa do Oeste (Brazil)
description: Blue field with a white cross, its intersection covered by a white lozenge bearing the municipal arms.
history: Formosa do Oeste is a municipality in the state of Paraná, Brazil. Flags of the World records that the flag and arms, designed by the heraldist and vexillologist Lauro Ribeiro Escobar, are prescribed by a municipal law whose number and date were not available; the arms stand for the municipal government and the cross for the spread of its power over the territory.

features.role: municipal arms, a lozengy shield with a mural crown between coffee and cotton, reading FORMOSA DO OESTE 8-12 1961
